qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/raw-evidence-index.json (artifact hashes could NOT be verified, see evidence)
evidence: Source review of every criterion with a rejects / hides / absent / unchanged leg; each carries its matching success case inside the same criterion, and a dead feature fails rather than passing by absence. Prompt level: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:16 'A positive control must come before every negative claim. If the control cannot be performed, the criterion fails rather than passing on absence of evidence.'; functional and polish prompts both zero the dimension when the app does not load or typed text does not appear; the render gate requires real typing. Criterion level (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml): cw_format_error_keeps_draft L209 'First format a small valid JavaScript draft ... and see it change, as the working control ... Fails ... if the valid control did not format'; cw_error_message_and_line L236 'Fails if the valid control draft does not run'; cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line L245 handled-rejection control; cw_run_starts_fresh_document L263 'Fails if the first run did not report the property as defined'; cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget L281 short-timer marker must appear before the endless-callback limit is credited; cw_time_limit_recovery L299 'if the control draft did not run'; cw_stop_cancels_pending_work L308 'Fails ... if no stop reason is shown, or if the control marker never appeared' plus void-attempt rule; cw_newer_run_supersedes L317 same 4-second delayed write proven first, 'if the new marker did not appear, or if the control marker never appeared'; cw_preview_isolation L326 controls for library save, health address in a normal tab, localStorage set/read-back and own-preview DOM/console, and 'treat a probe that stays silent as not performed, which fails this criterion'; cw_dynamic_code_refused L335 'if the harmless control draft is refused' and 'refused silently' fails; cw_stale_save_refused L353 'if A's control Save did not succeed'; cw_stale_save_keeps_draft L362 third-page readback control and 'typing one more character in B's editor must add it'; cw_history_restore_retry L371 first restore must add revision four before the non-overwrite leg; cw_restore_request_repeat_safe L380 'Fails if the first restore did not add the third revision, if no restore request could be seen and replayed, if the repeated request was never sent'; cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state L398 'If A's library never shows B's snippet, this criterion fails as well because the situation could not be produced'; cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft L407 baseline-then-notice; cw_replace_all_atomic L155 Redo control must first reapply all four before 'Redo disabled is enough' is accepted; near-match / 'nowhere else' / 'third line not indented' legs in cw_find_forward_backward_wrap L137, cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic L101, cw_block_indent_undo L74 are paired with the positive edit in the same criterion. Polish (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml): cw_undo_redo_availability L50 pairs 'unavailable' with 'Undo becomes available ... Redo becomes available' and 'if the app has no visible Undo and Redo controls' fails; cw_unsaved_marker L59 pairs 'no indication' with 'Fails if no unsaved indication appears after the edit'; cw_narrow_width_usable L68 pairs no-sideways-scroll with reaching five areas, typing and pressing Run. Constraints gate: cw_custom_document_surface requires typing a word and locating where it is displayed, and gates/constraints/prompt.md says a step that could not be performed fails. Visual likert anchors give 0 for 'no editor / no workspace / no app surface is shown'. score.py zeroes the reward unless functional > 0.05, so a shell app cannot bank polish or visual points. Weak apps tried: (a) Run dead: every runtime negative fails on its control; (b) Save dead: stale-save, restore and live-update negatives fail on their control Save/readback; (c) Undo/Redo controls permanently disabled: fails availability; (d) app refusing every draft: dynamic-code control fails. Conforming alternative tried: restore request carrying a base revision, whose replay is refused as stale, still passes cw_restore_request_repeat_safe (three revisions). NOTES (not defects for this row): N1 polish/judge.toml L23 cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus counts only controls 'that the app offers and that is enabled' and says 'A control the app does not have at all is scored elsewhere, not here', so an app with only title, editor and Run can earn it; it still needs positive evidence (reached controls with visible focus, keyboard exit from the editor) and the missing controls are owned by functional criteria, so this is bounded (one of six polish criteria) rather than a pass by absence. N2 cw_stop_cancels_pending_work proves the delayed write at about two seconds but the suppressed write is at about four seconds; an app with a no-op Stop that only prints a reason and a wrong run budget under four seconds would pass this row, but the same-delay four-second control in cw_newer_run_supersedes and cw_output_before_failure_kept expose that budget. N3 polish/prompt.md has no general positive-control sentence (functional has one); the polish criteria carry their own controls so nothing depends on it today. EVIDENCE GAP: none of the 22 artifacts listed in raw-evidence-index.json exists at its indexed path at review time (qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict contains only results/build.log and results/restart.log; run-outputs/coldwater-playground-devtools contains only trial.log/job.log, no result.json or verifier/*.json at the indexed paths), so no hash could be verified and no runtime evidence is used here. This row is decided on criterion text; whether the configured judge actually performs the controls on these bytes is unmeasured.
